name: ai-orchestrator
description: Orchestrates the BUILD once idea, spec and architecture are settled (not a spec tool): readiness gate, guided setup questionnaire, skills plan, parallel lanes across AI tools, one merge gate, provider failover, never-twice memory, reporting.

interface.shortDescription: Run a multi-agent build once the spec is settled
interface.longDescription: Starts where your spec work ends: checks the settled spec is ready to build, asks how you want to run the build (tools, lanes, models, skills), sets up the workspace, runs parallel lanes with one merge gate, keeps every tool busy with the work it does best, fails over on usage limits, and reports progress.
defaultPrompt: Set up the build orchestration for my app - the spec is in docs/
